clue.text: District hospital to the east of capital

indicators.note: in an across clue the hospital letter sits to the right, i.e. east, of the capital

parts.note: Paris is the capital of France
H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A neighbourhood hospital located just east of a nation's capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: A parish is an administrative or church district, a local area of a town or county.

clue.text: A component in pieces

parts.note: a part is a component of a machine

explanation.surface: A machine part lies broken into fragments.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken to bits or separated into sections, as in fell apart, means in pieces.

clue.text: Secret involving house and publican

indicators.note: the secret word encloses the house word

parts.note: inner means private or secret, as in inner thoughts
to keep is to house or lodge, as with livestock

explanation.surface: A confidential matter concerning a building and a pub landlord.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words name the landlord who runs a pub or inn.

clue.text: Hard, somewhat, in outward appearance

parts.note: H stands for hard, as on pencils
a bit means somewhat or slightly

explanation.surface: Someone looks rather tough on the outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Habit can mean bearing or bodily constitution, the general outward look of a person or plant.

clue.text: Primate could give bishop a blessing

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop
a boon is a blessing or godsend

explanation.surface: An ape might grant a churchman a benediction, a picture of a monkey blessing a bishop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Primate' looks like an archbishop beside 'bishop', but here it is the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The baboon is a large African monkey, a member of the primate order of mammals.

clue.text: He conducted in Swiss capital, good man, a German

parts.note: Bern is the capital of Switzerland
ST, saint, is a good man in crosswords
ein is German for a

explanation.surface: A worthy German man led an orchestra in Switzerland's capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonard Bernstein was the celebrated American conductor of the New York Philharmonic.

clue.text: Sounds like one who has a lighter spicy starter

indicators.note: the word for the boatman is pronounced the same as the snack

parts.note: a lighter is a flat-bottomed barge, so its boatman is a bargee

explanation.surface: A smoker with a cigarette lighter seems to be eating something spicy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lighter' suggests flame; here it is a barge, worked by a BARGEE.
explanation.definitionFit: This deep-fried Indian vegetable fritter is a common appetiser before curry.

clue.text: Start to make a speech having swallowed one drink

indicators.note: the speech word takes the other pieces inside it

parts.note: to orate is to deliver a speech
I is the Roman numeral one
gin is a spirit, a drink

explanation.surface: An after-dinner speaker downs a single drink before beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: To originate is to begin or arise, the verb sense of start.

clue.text: French writer keeping quiet for academic grounds?

indicators.note: the writer's name holds the quiet letter

parts.note: Albert Camus was the French author of The Outsider
p, piano, is the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: A French author stays silent, perhaps for scholarly reasons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grounds' reads as reasons; it means land.
explanation.definitionFit: The land and buildings of a university or college form its site.

clue.text: Grab lift

definitions.meaning: to steal, or the weightlifting move raising the bar overhead in one go

explanation.surface: Seize and raise.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means seize suddenly; lift in the slang sense of steal is a synonym too.

clue.text: Range fashionable once more

parts.note: an Aga is a well-known brand of kitchen range or cooker
in means fashionable, as in the in thing

explanation.surface: A kitchen stove is back in vogue once more.
explanation.walkthrough: An AGA is a heavy cast-iron range cooker, a fixture of British country kitchens.
explanation.definitionFit: Both expressions mean a further time, a repetition of what happened before.

clue.text: Brute, Scotsman, perhaps behind bars

indicators.note: the name comes after, i.e. behind, the bars in the answer

parts.note: the plural bars gives two copies of the word bar
Ian is a typically Scottish first name, so a Scotsman perhaps

explanation.surface: A violent Scot is locked up in prison.
explanation.definitionFit: A barbarian is an uncivilised, savage person, so a brute in the sense of a brutal man.

clue.text: Doctor's client, long-suffering

definitions.meaning: someone under a physician's medical care
able to put up with delay or trouble calmly

explanation.surface: A GP's customer who has endured a lot, waiting endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is a person receiving medical treatment; the adjective means tolerant and uncomplaining under hardship.

clue.text: What may help some sporty types to get up?

definitions.text: What may help some sporty types to get up?

parts.words: What may help some sporty types to get up?
parts.note: reads like an alarm clock or energy drink for athletes, but means a machine carrying people up a snowy slope

explanation.surface: Something that gets athletic people out of bed in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get up' suggests rising from bed; it really means ascending a mountain.
explanation.definitionFit: A ski lift is a cable-hauled chair or tow that carries skiers up the slope.

clue.text: Sailor about to collect special gunpowder ingredient

indicators.note: the sailor-and-about pair gathers the word for special into its middle

parts.note: an old salt is an experienced sailor
re means about or concerning
pet means special or favourite, as in a pet project

explanation.surface: A seaman is about to pick up a particular component for making explosives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' reads as 'on the point of'; split it: 'about' is RE and 'to collect' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Potassium nitrate, known as saltpetre, is the oxidising component of black powder.

clue.text: Idle girl makes a stand

parts.note: lazy means idle
Susan is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A slothful young woman takes a firm position.
explanation.definitionFit: A revolving tray on a dining table is a stand for serving dishes.

clue.text: Perplex with support for reversion to an earlier type

parts.note: to throw someone is to disconcert or perplex them
to back is to support

explanation.surface: Confusing someone while also endorsing a return to old ways.
explanation.definitionFit: In biology the term names an organism showing ancestral traits, a reappearance of older characteristics.

clue.text: Outbreak of fighting heading for cup tie

indicators.note: the initial letter of cup heads the word, so we take only that

parts.note: to lash is to tie or bind with rope

explanation.surface: A violent skirmish breaks out ahead of a knockout cup match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cup tie' suggests a football fixture; 'tie' here is the verb, to bind.
explanation.definitionFit: A clash is a short violent confrontation, as in clashes between police and protesters.

clue.text: Angry over promise to provide this

indicators.note: in a down entry the first word sits above, over, the second

parts.note: cross means angry
to give your word is to promise

explanation.surface: Someone furious about a vow to supply something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'this' points at the puzzle the solver is doing.
explanation.definitionFit: The self-referring pronoun points to the very puzzle being solved, a word grid.

clue.text: What shapes beard worn by preacher, a Zoroastrian

indicators.note: the letters are carried inside the words that follow, like a garment worn by them

explanation.surface: A Zoroastrian preacher's beard and the tool used to trim it.
explanation.definitionFit: A blade for shaving is what trims and shapes facial hair.

clue.text: Page on Rex, academy's headmaster?

indicators.note: in a down entry the R is placed on, i.e. after, the page word

parts.note: a recto is a right-hand page of a book
R stands for Rex, king, as in royal signatures

explanation.surface: A king's page reports to the head of a school.
explanation.walkthrough: In Scotland the head teacher of an academy is often called the rector.
explanation.definitionFit: The principal of certain Scottish secondary schools and some colleges holds this title.

clue.text: Deteriorate? Manage to consult foremost of doctors

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
to see a doctor is to consult one

indicators.note: only the front letter of doctors is used

explanation.surface: Someone getting worse manages to see the top doctors.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant that goes to seed stops being productive, hence the idiom for declining through neglect.

clue.text: Governess expected girl to be upset

parts.note: due means expected, as in the train is due

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the girl's name is read backwards

parts.note: Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A governess anticipated that a young girl would be distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: A duenna is an older woman acting as chaperone and governess to girls in a Spanish family.

clue.text: Caught a programme about Conservative's dependable way to boost the coffers

definitions.text: dependable way to boost the coffers

parts.note: C is the cricket scoring abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: the programme word wraps round the party letter

parts.note: a show is a television or radio programme
C is the abbreviation for Conservative in British politics

explanation.surface: A Tory gets caught out over a television show about fundraising.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a business or product generating steady profit with little effort, milked like a dairy animal.

clue.text: One who proclaims about state and Queen

parts.note: c, circa, means about
RI is the abbreviation for Rhode Island, a US state
ER, Elizabeth Regina, means Queen

explanation.surface: A herald making announcements about the nation and its monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A town crier shouted public announcements in the streets.

clue.text: Spend long period of time crossing

parts.note: to pass time is to spend it
an age is a long era

explanation.surface: Spending a great stretch of time on a journey across.
explanation.definitionFit: A passage is a voyage or journey across the sea, as in a rough crossing.

clue.text: Quick to forget former partner in a novel manufacturing business?

indicators.note: the former partner is dropped from the quick word

parts.note: express means fast, as in an express train
an ex is a former spouse or partner

explanation.surface: Someone eager to move on from an old flame in a new way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like 'new'; it is a book, which a publishing press produces.
explanation.definitionFit: A publishing house that prints books, fiction included, is a press.

clue.text: A young lady that's out of order

parts.note: a miss is a young unmarried woman

explanation.surface: A girl who is misbehaving.
explanation.definitionFit: Something wrong or awry is not in proper order.

clue.text: Refusing to bend, old boy, say, has to be carried around home

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

indicators.note: the word for say goes round the word for home, carrying it inside

parts.note: to state is to say
in means at home

explanation.surface: A stubborn former pupil, say, insists on being carried round his own house.
explanation.definitionFit: Stubbornly inflexible and unwilling to yield is exactly what this adjective describes.

clue.text: Hunter in oratorio, Nimrod

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of letters across the two words

explanation.surface: A hunter appears in an oratorio about Nimrod, the biblical mighty hunter.
explanation.walkthrough: Nimrod is itself a famous hunter and an Elgar piece, so the surface tempts a solver toward him.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the giant huntsman was placed among the stars as a constellation.

clue.text: A stink, ultimately, after article taken from another jacket

indicators.note: the A and final letter come after the shortened word
the article's letters are removed from the word another

parts.note: taken as written before the deletion
the is the definite article

indicators.note: the last letter of stink is used

explanation.surface: A smelly item is swapped for a different coat.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing T, H, E from ANOTHER leaves ANOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An anorak is a waterproof hooded jacket, a windcheater.

clue.text: Cruel person, notice, is skulking in street

indicators.note: lurking inside the street abbreviation

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement

explanation.surface: A cruel individual lurks in the road, with a sign announcing it.
explanation.definitionFit: One who takes pleasure in inflicting pain on others is a cruel person.
